canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON without whitespace; keys: mode, number, answer, translation, meaning, then hint and hintEn when present.

passes.method: First pass curated and normalized every SCOWL answer, PT-BR translation, meaning, and both optional PT-BR and English clues.

A separate procedural pass independently audited every record for sense and word-class alignment, natural PT-BR and English, circularity, clue leakage and similarity, mechanical families, duplication, prohibited content, and truncation; no human review.
